subject: 30-minute walkthrough — scheduling & SME alignment
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@orionai.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: 30-minute walkthrough — scheduling & SME alignment

Alex — great conversation today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next step so we can keep momentum: 

- Summary from discovery: you and Priya highlighted the need for low-latency inference in batch workflows, RBAC for model access, and a short pilot to validate prompt fidelity. I captured the notes and dropped a short discovery PDF (attached).

Proposed next meeting: a 30-minute product walkthrough (high-level demo + 10 minutes Q&A). During that session we usually cover integration touchpoints, basic throughput expectations, and show the Console metrics you asked about. If you want a deeper architecture session we can follow with a 60-min tech deep-dive.

Please pick one of these 30-minute windows (all PT):
- Wed 7 Oct, 10:00–10:30
- Thu 8 Oct, 14:00–14:30
- Fri 9 Oct, 11:30–12:00 (flex for Priya)

Two quick asks for the session to be productive:
1) Can you confirm who from Orion will join (product, infra/ops, decision owner)?
2) If you want the walkthrough to include an integration sketch with your ETL, please share a sample ingestion spec or a short note on rate/size.

I attached a draft mutual action plan (MAP-v1.docx) — safe to treat as a starting point. If any of those slots work, I’ll lock the calendar and loop in Neha to lead the technical portion.

Thanks — looking forward to lining this up.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0183
Redwood Inference

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf, MAP-v1.docx

From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@orionai.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@orionai.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: 30-minute walkthrough — scheduling & SME alignment

Sean — thanks, helpful recap. We want the 30-min to be product-forward but with a quick ops check so Priya (infra lead) will be on. Priya and I can make two of those windows work:

- Thu 8 Oct, 14:00–14:30 (preferred)
- Fri 9 Oct, 11:30–12:00 (backup)

Attendees from our side: Alex Torres (product), Priya Singh (infra), and I’ll invite our ML platform lead if schedules allow.

We have one ask up front: does Redwood capture per-request audit metadata for inference calls (user id, model version, timestamp)? That’s going to be a requirement for our audit trail. If Neha can touch on logging during the walkthrough that would be great.

I took a look at the MAP docx — will review and send comments.

Regards,
Alex
Head of Product, OrionAI
alex.torres@orionai.com

> Attachment: org-org-roles.csv (internal reference)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@orionai.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@orionai.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: 30-minute walkthrough — scheduling & SME alignment

Thanks Alex — locking Thu 8 Oct 14:00–14:30 PT for the 30-minute walkthrough (calendar invite to follow). Neha will lead the demo and spend ~5–7 minutes on logging/audit features to address your question. High level plan for the 30-min:

- 0–5m: quick recap & goals (Sean)
- 5–20m: product walkthrough + Console metrics (Neha) — includes logging/audit note and model versioning demo
- 20–30m: next steps + agree pilot scope (all)

If your ML platform lead can join, great; otherwise we can schedule a follow-up 60-minute deep-dive next week to map the integration with your ETL and auth model.

For convenience I added two links — pick the one you prefer to add to your calendars:
- 30-min walkthrough (Thu 8 Oct, 14:00 PT): https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=orion-preview
- 60-min deep-dive (options): https://calendly.com/redwood/60min-tech-deepdive

Monica (CS) — can you attach the short pre-call checklist so Alex/Priya know what to have on hand?

Sean

On attachments: I’m re-attaching MAP-v1 and discovery-notes for your review.

Regards,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@orionai.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@orionai.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: 30-minute walkthrough — scheduling & SME alignment

Alex/Priya — thanks, I’ll lead the walkthrough on Thursday. Quick note on logging/audit: Redwood records per-request metadata (request id, model id+version, timestamp, requester id) and can stream logs to your SIEM or Cloud Storage; I’ll show the Console capture and how to configure export. Also attached a short pre-call infra checklist (pre-call-infra-checklist.txt) with items that help us demo your specific flow (sample prompt, typical request rates, expected peak concurrency).

If you can drop a sample ingestion spec or a brief note on average tokens per request before Thu that will let us tailor two slides to your environment. No worries if not — we’ll keep the walkthrough generic and follow-up with a tech deep-dive.

See you Thursday,
Neha Kapoor
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

Attachments: pre-call-infra-checklist.txt
